```{r}
timestamp()
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(here)
source(here("utils","check_packages.R"))
source(here("utils","functions.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| include: false

load(here("data", "data_constructed", "model_data.RData"))
```

```{r}
#| label: set-future-plans

if(interactive()) {
  plan(multisession, workers = min(detectCores() - 1, params$n_workers))
} else {
  plan(multicore, workers = min(detectCores() - 1, params$n_workers))
}
```


```{r}
#| label: estimate-state-model-overall

# first do single race groups
tic()
model_state_bs <- data_model_state |>
  bootstrap_model(c("White", "Black", "Indigenous", "Asian", "Hispanic"), 
                  composition_var = "state", year_separate = TRUE)
toc()

# now add in each multiracial pairwise comparison
tic()
model_state_bs <- data_model_state |>
  bootstrap_model(c("White", "White-Black"),
                  composition_var = "state", year_separate = TRUE) |>
  bind_rows(model_state_bs)
toc()

tic()
model_state_bs <- data_model_state |>
  bootstrap_model(c("Black", "White-Black"),
                  composition_var = "state", year_separate = TRUE) |>
  bind_rows(model_state_bs)
toc()

tic()
model_state_bs <- data_model_state |>
  bootstrap_model(c("White", "White-Indigenous"),
                  composition_var = "state", year_separate = TRUE) |>
  bind_rows(model_state_bs)
toc()

tic()
model_state_bs <- data_model_state |>
  bootstrap_model(c("Indigenous", "White-Indigenous"),
                  composition_var = "state", year_separate = TRUE) |>
  bind_rows(model_state_bs)
toc()

tic()
model_state_bs <- data_model_state |>
  bootstrap_model(c("White", "White-Asian"),
                  composition_var = "state", year_separate = TRUE) |>
  bind_rows(model_state_bs)
toc()

tic()
model_state_bs <- data_model_state |>
  bootstrap_model(c("Asian", "White-Asian"),
                  composition_var = "state", year_separate = TRUE) |>
  bind_rows(model_state_bs)
toc()

tic()
model_state_bs <- data_model_state |>
  bootstrap_model(c("Black", "Black-Indigenous"),
                  composition_var = "state", year_separate = TRUE) |>
  bind_rows(model_state_bs)
toc()

tic()
model_state_bs <- data_model_state |>
  bootstrap_model(c("Indigenous", "Black-Indigenous"),
                  composition_var = "state", year_separate = TRUE) |>
  bind_rows(model_state_bs)
toc()

tic()
model_state_bs <- data_model_state |>
  bootstrap_model(c("Black", "Black-Asian"),
                  composition_var = "state", year_separate = TRUE) |>
  bind_rows(model_state_bs)
toc()

tic()
model_state_bs <- data_model_state |>
  bootstrap_model(c("Asian", "Black-Asian"),
                  composition_var = "state", year_separate = TRUE) |>
  bind_rows(model_state_bs)
toc()

model_state_bs <- model_state_bs |>
  arrange(term, year)

save(model_state_bs, 
     file = here("data", "data_constructed", "model_state_bs.RData"))
```

```{r}
#| label: timestamp-end
#| echo: false

timestamp()
```
